title: TransientWaveCompiler: structure as a compilable operator and realization ambiguity
summary: TransientWaveCompiler is an unusually literal bridge between the Geometric Neuron physical-computation line and two later themes that recur across the genealogy. It grew directly from GeometricNeuronPlusField and extracted a practical compiler abstraction: geometry/topology becomes a sparse reciprocal operator, the operator produces a measurable response or transient, and exact sensitivities connect response back to physical parameters or hardware lowering. At the same time, its filter-diagnosis work makes an equally important negative result explicit: the same external response can admit multiple response-equivalent internal physical realizations, so diagnosis must sometimes report non-identifiability and choose a perturbation rather than force a unique topology. That combination anticipates both Operaattori's morphology-to-operator compiler and the later identifiability/active-intervention line without implying direct ancestry where the repositories do not claim it.

nodes.claim: Compiles declared reciprocal geometry/topology into a sparse physical operator and measurable response, exposes exact inverse-matrix sensitivities for diagnosis/lowering, and explicitly audits when static response cannot uniquely identify the internal physical realization.
nodes.survived: The software compiler/diagnosis line survived the hardware detour: exact reciprocal response sensitivities, nuisance-aware physical fitting, Touchstone ingestion, repeated-state comparison, topology capability audits and perturbation anchors remain useful independently of whether a stochastic physical adjoint works. The topology-only audit correctly identifies response-equivalent gauge directions and can state which known resonator perturbation would break an exact ambiguity.
nodes.killed: The attractive TW-1A small-cap stochastic physical-adjoint story failed controlled tests: even heavy averaging retained poor alignment with the clean gradient, so a stochastic reverse history could not be treated as an automatic adjoint of the stochastic forward history. The filter line also shows that breaking an exact realization gauge is necessary but not sufficient for robust finite-noise topology discovery after a flexible wrong-model fit has compensated.

edges.why: TransientWaveCompiler explicitly states that it grew out of GeometricNeuronPlusField, carrying the geometry-defined operator idea into sparse reciprocal physical operators, exact sensitivities and hardware/software lowering.

The repositories independently instantiate the same structural-compilation abstraction at different substrates: TWC maps physical topology to a reciprocal operator and exact parameter sensitivity, while Operaattori maps morphology to a cable/nonlinear operator and exact geometry tangent. This is a mechanism rhyme rather than a claimed ancestry relation.

motifs.title: Structure can be compiled into an executable operator
motifs.description: GeometricNeuronPlusField treats frozen anatomy as an operator that constrains a moving field. TransientWaveCompiler makes that idea literal in a physical compiler: declared geometry/topology becomes a sparse reciprocal operator, response and exact sensitivity. Operaattori later performs the analogous lowering from real morphology to cable transport plus local nonlinear closure, while GrowingAnttisNeuron asks how developmental rules can manufacture the structure being compiled. The shared object is not visual geometry but a reproducible map from structure to executable dynamics.

motifs.title: The same behavior does not uniquely identify the internal realization
motifs.description: TransientWaveCompiler encounters response-equivalent reciprocal topologies: identical static response can leave literal physical edges unidentifiable until an informative perturbation is applied. NotSoSimpleNeuron reaches a related realization boundary when a linear dendritic branch bank collapses exactly to an alternative modal state-space realization. NeuralAlgorithmDecoding reaches the same epistemic boundary at the algorithm level and explicitly returns NOT_IDENTIFIABLE when available interventions cannot distinguish hidden mechanisms. Across physical topology, dynamical realization and learned computation, matching output is weaker than identifying the mechanism that produced it.

motifs.title: When observation cannot identify the mechanism, choose another experiment
motifs.description: TransientWaveCompiler does not try to optimize through missing information: its capability audit exposes realization-gauge directions and names perturbation anchors that can break exact ambiguity. The later active-observation line generalizes that move into a policy: identify what the current view cannot resolve, then select an intervention or measurement that separates the remaining hypotheses. This is an early concrete physical instance of the later active-identification machinery.
